name: Antique Mall
summary: The Encinitas Antique Mall is a charming North County treasure trove featuring vintage furniture, home décor, and rare collectibles from diverse independent dealers. Part of the Consignment Classics family since 1997, this coastal destination offers shoppers one-of-a-kind finds in a picturesque Encinitas location.
demographics: The Encinitas Antique Mall attracts a diverse demographic of vintage enthusiasts, collectors, and coastal residents with disposable income for unique home décor and antiques. The primary visitor base consists of affluent homeowners aged 35-65 in the North County San Diego coastal communities, with household incomes typically exceeding $100,000. The picturesque Encinitas location draws both local treasure hunters and tourists seeking one-of-a-kind pieces, with shoppers valuing sustainability, craftsmanship, and distinctive vintage finds over mass-produced items.
description: The Encinitas Antique Mall, located at 211 South El Camino Real in the picturesque coastal town of Encinitas, is part of the Consignment Classics family of stores that has been serving San Diego County since 1997. This charming North County treasure trove offers visitors a diverse selection of vintage furniture, home décor, art, and rare collectibles curated by an eclectic group of independent dealers. Featured vendors include Horsefeathers, Coastal Mercantile, Banuet Import Co., 4 Deuces, EverStyle, AlohaMesa, Royal Pelican Antiques, Our Happy Place, Dogwood Design, Coolectibles, B.E. Vintage 56, Quick Fix Vintage Nostalgia, Oceanside Laurel, expunkrockmom, and The Villa, each bringing their unique specialty to the mall. The mall is conveniently located just steps away from Encinitas Consignment Classics and the Encinitas Décor Store, creating a shopping destination for those seeking exceptional secondhand treasures and vintage finds. With a 4.3-star rating and a commitment to sustainability by keeping goods out of landfills, the Encinitas Antique Mall has become a must-visit destination for locals and visitors alike who appreciate quality, variety, and the thrill of discovering one-of-a-kind pieces.
